TECHNOLOGIES

Bio-Disk®

Based on a unique fixed-bed aerobic system that ensures high performance with extremely low energy consumption and is optimal for rural and remote sites.

Bio-Robi®

Our patented  low cost technology can replace any septic system and is suitable for individual homes.

Green-Float DAF

To remove high organic loads we offer the "Green Float DAF" that provides very high separation efficiency with low operation costs.

SFT (Super Fat Trap)

Our advanced commercial  fat trap ensures removal with ease and efficiency and reduces significantly collection and disposal frequency.
